bull.b: Celsius converts a high share of earnings into cash (FCF ~ $293M; FCF/net income ~0.89), providing durable funding for reinvestment, buybacks and debt servicing. Solid cash conversion supports flexibility through commodity cycles and funds strategic growth despite near-term working-capital drag.

The multi-brand portfolio (Celsius, Alani Nu, Rockstar) and expanded placement have produced durable category scale and distribution reach. ~21% dollar share reflects structural market penetration; scale improves negotiating power, supports innovation rollout, and leverages PepsiCo distribution for sustained retail presence.

bull.t: High gross margins and operating leverage
bull.b: Unit economics remain strong with near-50% gross margins and improving SG&A as a percent of sales, indicating operating leverage. Captured merger synergies and SKU optimization point to sustainable margin recovery potential as manufacturing capacity and integration benefits scale over 2026–27.

bear.b: Leverage increased materially compared with prior low-debt levels, reducing financial flexibility. Higher debt loads raise interest and refinancing sensitivity, constrain capital allocation choices, and limit the company's buffer against extended cost pressures or slower organic growth in the medium term.

bear.t: Compressed net margins vs prior peaks
bear.b: Despite revenue growth and strong gross margins, net and operating margins have meaningfully compressed versus 2023–24. Lower bottom-line profitability reduces retained earnings accumulation, weakens return-on-equity upside, and leaves less room for absorbing persistent input-cost or integration-related headwinds.

bear.t: Commodity, freight and integration timing risk
bear.b: Ongoing input-cost volatility and one-off freight/inventory impacts tied to Rockstar/Alani integration create structural timing risk for margin recovery. Delays in manufacturing capacity and stabilization increase the chance that synergy and margin gains arrive later, pressuring cash flow and execution over the next several quarters.
